summary: What the extraction cannot know, for the Kanturu Ruins: its camp's townspeople. MU and OpenMU stand nobody in the Ruins (VersionSeasonSix/Maps/KanturuRuins.cs has no CreateNpcSpawns); Baz and Amy stand here as in Tarkan, Atlans, the Lost Tower and Aida (the user, 2026-10-23: 'lets add kunturu npcs', then 'Both'). With MU's Elpis and Gateway Machine, brought here from the Tower and the Relics, which are not playable (the user: 'find better locations for them'). They are world.json's npcs 0-3; these are their figures.

spawns.ours: the camp vault on the grass two tiles off the cobbled way in, beside Amy, turned to the camera (Kanturu's camera puts north at the screen's foot)
the camp potion seller east of the way in, beside Baz, facing the camera
MU's refinery keeper before the north ruin wall, a shrine at the head of the camp, facing the camera
MU's Relics machine as the centrepiece of the lit east plaza between its brazier pairs, facing the camera
